== Emoji basic ==
😀 😃 😄 😁 😆 😅 😂 🤣 😊 😇 🙂 🙃 😉 😌 😍 🥰 😘 😗 😙 😚
🎉 🎊 🎈 🎁 🎀 🎗 🎟 🎫 🎖 🏆 🥇 🥈 🥉 🏅 🎽 🎮 🕹 🎲 🎯 🎳

== Emoji in context ==
User clicked 👆 the button ✅ and the process 🔄 completed 🎉
Error: ❌ File not found 📁 — please check the path 🗂️
Warning: ⚠️ Memory usage at 99% 📊 — system may be unstable 💥

== Multi-codepoint emoji (ZWJ sequences) ==
👨‍💻 👩‍💻 🧑‍💻 👨‍🎨 👩‍🎨 🧑‍🎨
👨‍🚀 👩‍🚀 🧑‍🚀 👨‍⚕️ 👩‍⚕️ 🏳️‍🌈 🏳️‍⚧️

== Flags (regional indicators) ==
🇮🇹 🇺🇸 🇬🇧 🇩🇪 🇫🇷 🇯🇵 🇨🇳 🇷🇺 🇧🇷 🇰🇷 🇦🇺 🇨🇦 🇲🇽 🇪🇸

== Combining characters ==
e + combining acute: é (two codepoints: U+0065 U+0301)
a + combining umlaut: ä (two codepoints: U+0061 U+0308)
n + combining tilde: ñ (two codepoints: U+006E U+0303)
Devanagari: क्ष (ksha, three codepoints)

== CJK wide characters (each occupies 2 terminal columns) ==
中文測試：这是一段中文文字，用于测试编辑器对中文字符的处理能力。
日本語テスト：これは日本語のテストです。エディタが全角文字を正しく扱えるかを確認します。
한국어 테스트: 이것은 한국어 테스트입니다. 편집기가 한국어 문자를 올바르게 처리하는지 확인합니다.

== Mixed ASCII and wide ==
File: /home/user/文档/测试.txt (12 bytes)
Error in 第3行 column 5: unexpected token '你好'
Path: C:\Users\用户名\Documents\文件夹\

== Arabic (right-to-left) ==
مرحبا بالعالم — Hello World in Arabic
هذا النص يحتوي على كلمات عربية مختلطة with English text
